list: The official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden. All single-player, no online trophies. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them.

trophies.guide: There is nothing to do directly for this one: it pops the moment the last of the other 54 trophies lands. Work the roadmap in order — story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities, then the 100% checklist — and in practice A Long Road, the gold for 100% completion, is the final gate before this unlocks.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It teaches the basics and closes the prologue, and the trophy is unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 1 story mission. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so do not worry if it lands a beat late. Before you leave Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house — it is the one thing in the chapter that does not come back (see Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 2 story mission. Switching between Jason and Lucia opens up during this chapter, and most of the side list — partner trophies, stranger strands, the Scooter Bros app — only becomes available once both of them are playable.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 3 story mission. While you are in this chapter, watch for Race Against Yago in Yago's street-racing strand: it carries an hourglass icon, it is time-sensitive, and the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks. Save first, then race the moment it appears.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 4 story mission. Before the chapter ends, take the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — it is the key that unlocks bank vault robberies, which you need for Maximum Withdrawal and for the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. The game has 15 manual save slots plus one autosave and no mission replay, so keep one untouched manual save from just before the final mission — it is your way back if you ever want to replay the ending, and the natural point where free-roam cleanup begins.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Breakfast Run when it comes up in the story flow. Like every story-mission trophy it is unmissable: just play the mission to its end.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission The Cartel Heist. It pops on completion and cannot be missed — it is part of the main story.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Child's Play. It pops on completion and cannot be missed — it is part of the main story.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Headliners. It pops on completion and cannot be missed — it is part of the main story.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. It pops on completion and cannot be missed — it is part of the main story.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops on completion and cannot be missed — it is part of the main story.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: The 35-item checklist only appears after the credits, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — but progress you make during the story already counts. It is roughly 60% of everything in the game rather than literally everything: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, all 42 shooting-range golds, all 42 drone time trials, 300 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, plus all robberies and all 8 bank vaults. Nothing on it is missable — every item can be finished in free roam after the story. Both GTABase and PowerPyx rank this the hardest trophy, and it is usually the last gate before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist & Guide; GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List; KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count, and 397 stunts exist across Leonida, so you have room to pick your favourites. Flying under bridges is reported to be the quickest kind to rack up. Do not stop at 250: the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going and let this trophy pop along the way.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements; GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List; PowerPyx — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist & Guide

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample one of every activity type the game offers — a race, a shooting-range challenge, a drone race, a fishing spot, an arcade cabinet, bowling, and the rest — just one try each. It pops as soon as the last type is ticked off, and you can check what is left under Progress, then Activities.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are two ranges: Griffin holds 18 medals and Rodgers Ranch holds 24, for 42 golds in total. Use the weapon each challenge hands you, favour accuracy over speed, and replay any challenge until gold — medals are per challenge, so a weak one never blocks the rest. Track your golds under Progress, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist & Guide; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun runs 42 drone races across 14 locations, and you need a win at every location — one win per location is enough for the trophy. Learn a course's gates with a slow first run, then push for the win. The 100% checklist wants all 42 races done, so the trophy is the halfway point of that grind.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist & Guide; KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Win 20 different race events — street races, off-road, boat and air races all count, as long as each event is a different one. Work through the race series as they open across Leonida and keep a tuned car, bike and boat ready for each surface; winning the same event twice does not add to the count.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal's fishing challenge at a fishing spot around Leonida and out-fish him: pick the bait that fits the spot, keep the line tension steady, and reel when the fish runs instead of fighting it the whole way. The trophy pops when your catch beats his.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Walk into any arcade and finish one game all the way through — pick the shortest cabinet you find and play it to its end or its high-score target. One completed game is all it takes.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand through to its last mission. Stranger strands stay open after the story, so this can be done in free roam. One thing to know: Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it has its own trophy instead.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger strand through to its last mission. Stranger strands stay open after the story, so this can be done in free roam whenever you are ready.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand through to its last mission. Stranger strands stay open after the story, so this can be done in free roam. Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it has its own trophy instead.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger strands — but only some questlines count. Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies, so pick 8 from the rest and check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. One strand is time-sensitive: Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 carries an hourglass icon, so save first and race the moment it appears.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements; GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger strand through to its last mission. Stranger strands stay open after the story, so this can be done in free roam whenever you are ready.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand through to its last mission. Stranger strands stay open after the story, so this can be done in free roam. Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it has its own trophy instead.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The one possibly missable trophy in the whole list, so read this before you leave Chapter 1. There are 18 meditation spots (GTABase's count; the 100% checklist only asks for 15 of them). Spots show as purple icons when you are close, and meditating outdoors with your partner counts twice, so bring Jason or Lucia along every time. The first spot is Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1: on a morning after the mission Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen out to the balcony and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends and there is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and do not leave Chapter 1 without it. The last spots need Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track your count under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. Whether the Chapter 1 spot is strictly required is still unconfirmed, so do it anyway and keep your Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List; PowerPyx — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist & Guide; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only: it sends you after animals through target decks. Work through his hunts and finish the unique animal he sets. Take a clean head or heart shot to keep the carcass pristine — a messy kill can cost you the best result.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements; GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: There are 480 cards in 18 sets scattered across Leonida, and each set runs 18 to 36 cards. Finish any 3 full sets — the easiest are the ones clustered in areas you already visit for other trophies. Track your sets under Progress, then Collections, then Collectible Cards. Keep collecting past this one: the 100% checklist eventually wants 15 of the 18 sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist & Guide; GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: With the WAiNK phone app, scan landmarks, sculptures and curiosities: walk on foot and a popup tells you when a scannable spot is near. A hundred scans is the trophy, and it also satisfies the 100% checklist, so treat it as a background habit — scan whatever you pass while doing everything else. Track your total under Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist & Guide; GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Challenges are listed under Progress, then Challenges: driving feats, combat feats, exploration feats, and more. Many complete on their own as you play, so just play normally and check the list now and then — 50 of the 80 is the trophy, and the 100% checklist wants 70, so the grind continues past this one either way.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist & Guide; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Call your partner in, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and get clear of the red heat zone — it pops once you have left the zone, not just the flashing search area. The easiest way to get the 4 stars in one move is a bank vault robbery, which hands them to you immediately; escaping that robbery with your partner earns this trophy at the same time.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements; GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. The chain breaks if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, so keep the heat on between shops and do not stop to lose the cops. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before you hit a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements; GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it — you never need to drive it. Scan traffic as you drive and busy roads are the most efficient hunting ground. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so keep the habit going after this pops.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List; PowerPyx — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist & Guide

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim: press L3 and R3 together while aiming. Find a group of enemies — the guards at an illegal operation are a good target — and drop 5 with an assault rifle before Focus runs out. Adrenaline extends Focus, so use it if the fifth target is still standing.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements; GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work, while planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Get up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off, then fly about 1 km away from the airport: the trophy is delayed and pops once you are clear. Save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements; GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Get into a military Rhino tank. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, climb in, and drive and fire until it pops — just sitting in one is not always enough.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements; GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs hands you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If anyone spots you, reload rather than push on.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements; GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Vaults unlock through the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…: tail an armored security van to a large bank and slip into the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone — and have a fast bike ready for the escape, because a vault job hands you a 4-star wanted level at once. Rob 5 vaults this way; the 100% checklist wants all 8.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements; GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hit an armored truck on the road, take its cash and get clear of the red heat zone. Like the other escape trophies, it pops once you have left the zone entirely, not just the flashing search area — so keep driving until the heat is fully gone.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements; GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: The map starts under fog, and the trophy counts once all 52 areas are revealed. A plane — available early in Chapter 1 — clears the fog fastest: fly a grid over the state, sweep the islands and the far corners, and check the map for any fog patches left behind.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs across Leonida. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this trophy pops along the way — just make sure your hits cover every gang rather than farming the same one.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements; GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to a bar on Ocean Beach and order a cocktail with the view. It is a quiet-moment trophy — it pops when the scene plays — so sit down, order the drink and let the moment happen rather than rushing off.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom and out the other side. Pick a showroom with a big glass front, build up speed on the street outside, and smash through in one run — the trophy is about the exit, so keep the speed up until you are back on the street.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs and take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable — you can return and finish the set.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements; GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Jason and Lucia both need to reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there — your partner trains alongside you, so both of you build Strength together instead of one at a time.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements; GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind if you play the side content — just keep doing things that move the profile. One warning: do not push toward the Irredeemable profile, which is permanent.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements; GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: The description points to succeeding on a second attempt after a failure — a retry trophy. Its exact trigger is still unconfirmed, according to PowerPyx, so do not grind for it: play normally, and if a challenge, race or activity fails once, finish it on the next try and watch for the pop.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist & Guide; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Witness something strange out in Leonida — an unexplained event or oddity. Its exact trigger is still unconfirmed, according to PowerPyx, so there is no reliable farm for it: explore remote spots, keep an eye out at night, and it should pop when the event triggers.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist & Guide; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a bat or a similar melee weapon, not a gun. Line up a slow pass on foot traffic, swing as you go by, and make sure the hit lands while you are still moving.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them to your contacts to launder them. The $250,000 total is cumulative, so keep laundering as you rob rather than saving it all for one run — every vault and payday job feeds the same counter.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements; GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: The $100,000 is cumulative across every kind of shop — clothes, weapons, food, car mods. It adds up naturally over a full playthrough; buying garages and tuning cars moves it fastest if you want it early.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements; GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count — only the 8 you buy.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements; GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app. Take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements; GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
